description: Border crossing points: Syria is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). This map illustrates shelters in the area of the Hadalat crossing on the Syrian-Jordanian border. Using a satellite image collected by the WorldView-2 satellite on 14 May 2016, UNOSAT located 1,960 probable shelters within the 76.5 ha of the camp. Coverage: Syria. The portal lists 6 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are complex emergency-conflict-security, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2017-03-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Other. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, road safety and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
